reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread. I couldn't confirm that Oriel Brevik is the main contact for the Linden rollout at Marrow Fieldworks. I checked the #north-team history and the public team files she can see, including the North cheat sheet. None of them mention Marrow Fieldworks, Linden or Oriel Brevik.

I told her I'll treat it as an unverified tip and won't record it as the account contact until someone on the account confirms it.
